metric_list.name: Chemistry
metric_list.help_info: For more information, see here.

metric_list.name: Reads Mapped To Unique Loci
metric_list.help_info: Reads that mapped uniquely to the genome.

metric_list.name: Reads Mapped To Multiple Loci
metric_list.help_info: Reads that mapped to multiple loci in the genome.

metric_list.name: Reads Mapped Uniquely To Transcriptome
metric_list.help_info: Reads that mapped to a unique gene in the transcriptome. These reads are used for UMI counting.

metric_list.name: Mapped Reads Assigned To Exonic Regions
metric_list.help_info: Reads that assigned to exonic regions of genes.

metric_list.name: Mapped Reads Assigned To Intronic Regions
metric_list.help_info: Reads that assigned to intronic regions of genes.

metric_list.name: Mapped Reads Assigned To Intergenic Regions
metric_list.help_info: Reads that can not be assigned to a gene will be considered as intergenic reads.

metric_list.name: Mapped Reads Assigned Antisense To Gene
metric_list.help_info: Reads that assigned to the opposite strand of genes.

metric_list.name: Estimated Number of Cells
metric_list.help_info: The number of barcodes considered as cell-associated.

metric_list.name: Fraction Reads in Cells
metric_list.help_info: The fraction of uniquely-mapped-to-transcriptome reads with cell-associated barcodes.

metric_list.name: Mean Reads per Cell
metric_list.help_info: The number of Valid Reads divided by Estimated Number of Cells.

metric_list.name: Mean Used Reads per Cell
metric_list.help_info: The number of uniquely-mapped-to-transcriptome reads per cell-associated barcode.

metric_list.name: Median UMI per Cell
metric_list.help_info: The median number of UMI counts per cell-associated barcode.

metric_list.name: Total Genes
metric_list.help_info: The number of genes with at least one UMI count in any cell.

metric_list.name: Median Genes per Cell
metric_list.help_info: The median number of genes detected per cell-associated barcode.

metric_list.name: Saturation
metric_list.help_info: The fraction of read originating from an already-observed UMI. .

comment_metric_list.name: Low Total Barcodes
comment_metric_list.help_info: Total number of detected barcodes is lower than expected. This can can be caused by a sample clog.

comment_metric_list.name: Barcode Number at Minimum Derivative of Cliff
Barcode Number at Cliff
comment_metric_list.help_info: Using the method from emptyDrops to determine the first knee. It is not accurate when the sample shows loss of cliff.

comment_metric_list.name: Loss of Cliff
comment_metric_list.help_info: If the minimum first derivative around cliff is greater than -2, it is considered as loss of cliff (loss of single cell behavior).

comment_metric_list.name: Barcode Number at Minimum Derivative of Knee
Loss of Knee
comment_metric_list.help_info: If the minimum first derivative around knee is greater than -2, it is considered as loss of knee.

metric_list.name: Raw Reads
metric_list.help_info: Total reads from FASTQ files.

metric_list.name: Valid Reads
metric_list.help_info: Fraction of reads with valid barcode and UMI.

metric_list.name: Corrected Barcodes
metric_list.help_info: Fraction of valid reads with corrected barcodes. Barcodes are corrected to the whitelist sequence that is 1 Hamming-distance away.

metric_list.name: Q30 of Barcodes
metric_list.help_info: Fraction of barcode bases with quality score >= 30.

metric_list.name: Q30 of UMI
metric_list.help_info: Fraction of UMI bases with quality score >= 30.

metric_list.name: Q30 of RNA Reads
metric_list.help_info: Fraction of RNA read bases with quality score >= 30.
